spans.s:
m. (-षः)
Nourishing, cherishing.
E.
पुष to nourish, aff. घञ्; also with ल्युट् aff. पोषण.

n. (-णं)
Nourishing, cherishing.
E.
पुष to nourish, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be cherished or protected.
E.
पुष to nourish, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-त्नुः-त्नुः-त्नु)
Nourishing, cherishing.
m. (-त्नुः)
The Koïl or Indian cuckoo.
E.
पुष to nourish, in the causal form, इत्नुच् aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be cherished or protected.
E.
पुष, and तव्य aff.

mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ)
Who or what nourishes, cherishes, &c.
m. (-ष्टा)
1 Grey bonduc.
2 A protector, a cherisher.
E.
पुष to nourish, aff. तृच्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Who or what nourishes best.
E.
पोष्टृ, and वर best.

mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं)
To be cherished or taken care of.
E.
पुष to nourish, यत् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Cherishing dependants.
2 Being taken care of.
E.
पोष्य, and त्व aff.

m. (-त्त्रः)
An adopted son.
E.
पोष्य, and पुत्त्र a son.

m. (-र्गः)
A class of persons or objects to be cherished, as parents, children, guests, and the sacred fire.
E.
पोष्य, and वर्ग a class.
